gaps.explanation: The report's own two printed General Fund totals differ by 53: statement p3 General column Total Disbursements 35,245,270 (fund balance end 19,490,476) vs the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule p5 Total Disbursements actual 35,245,217 (fund balance end 19,490,529; net change 1,803,347 vs 1,803,294 on p3). The detail General Fund spending lines (department schedule p10) tie to the schedule's 35,245,217; every other fund ties to its p3 column. Statement 57,164,868 - schedule 57,164,815 = 53. Nothing printed to add; already listed in report_discrepancies.

Road Fund transfer in is in detail but not recognised as a transfer: p6 Road Fund schedule prints it under 'County Transfers' as 'Inter-Fund From General (Maintenance)' 2,380,656, and the p3 statement Road Fund column prints Transfers In 2,380,656. detail[153] carries the printed sub-label, so it is not counted as Transfers In. Replace it with the same amount labelled 'Transfers In'. Detail transfers in then = General 2,000,000 + Inheritance 24,406 + Road 2,380,656 + Insurance 668,362 + Courthouse Bond 819,000 + Nonmajor 616,352 = 6,508,776 = statement Transfers In 6,508,776 (p3). 4,128,120 - 2,380,656 + 2,380,656 + 2,380,656 = 6,508,776.
